icons.name: Wipf · full body
icons.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's 76x102 screenshot of a full-body Wipf creature used as a slider thumb on a beige game interface. Image 2 shows the authoritative original full-body Wipf on the left and the small exact slider sprite on the right. Image 3 shows a previous enlarged full-body reconstruction as a shape/rendering guide ONLY; completely disregard its gray/white checkerboard background.
Make a faithful high-resolution restoration of the WHOLE SCREENSHOT IN IMAGE 1, including the ENTIRE seated Wipf and the horizontal slider rail behind it.
Composition must match Image 1: portrait canvas approx 3:4 aspect ratio. Plain warm pale tan/beige interface background throughout. A narrow horizontal gray/taupe recessed slider rail crosses the entire canvas behind the Wipf at roughly the middle height, with subtle bevel/shadow matching the screenshot. The creature sits IN FRONT of this rail and occludes it. Preserve the relative size: the complete creature spans approximately 54 percent of the canvas width and 48 percent of its height, with ear tips near 28 percent from the top and paws near 76 percent from the top. Its center is around 54 percent of canvas width. Include ample beige space above, below, and to both sides just as the original screenshot.
Creature: match the left full-body original in Image 2. Complete seated ochre/brown furry Wipf, front-facing with a subtle turn toward viewer's left. Two raised bent broad-tipped ears with dark inner portions; big white eyes, dark pupils, shiny black nose, rounded golden muzzle and two SHORT small separated pale front teeth (as in the original, not long projecting tusks); stout round body; two short thick front legs leading to front paws flat on the ground; broad rounded rump/haunch bulging on the right and visible hind paws. The head must remain attached to the fully visible body with all paws and bottom contour present. Preserve source proportions rather than exaggerating the head.
Restore smooth high-resolution contours and shading and restrained fine fuzzy surface detail in the original prerendered game-art style. No blocky pixels, mosaic, portrait crop, body crop, cut-off paws, generic rabbit redesign, extra legs, labels or watermark.
Render the background as ordinary solid beige opaque pixels with the slider rail. Absolutely no checkerboard pattern, no transparent-background visualization. Output one high-resolution screenshot restoration, not a comparison board.
